newsitem.title: USA: AOL Q2 loss bigger than forecast due to pact.
newsitem.headline: AOL Q2 loss bigger than forecast due to pact.

text.p: America Online Inc's second quarter net loss of $1.64 a share was bigger than most Wall Street analysts forecast, because the loss included an unexpected charge of about $24 million stemming from its settlement with the 36 state attorneys general.

Most analysts had not expected AOL to record the charge for its refund and credits to members resulting from its recent preliminary agreement with the attorneys general January 29 in the current quarter.
Abhishek Gami, an analyst with Nesbitt Burns Securities, said he was expecting a loss, after charges, of $1.34 a share.
Gami included in his net loss forecast the charge of $74.3 million from the company's previously announced restructuring.
According to First Call, the Wall Street consensus was for a loss of $0.55 a share, before any restructuring charges.
